title: コンクリート製輪止め
description: 固定用貫通穴と両側の黄色い反射板を備える面取りされたコンクリート製輪止め。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A chamfered precast parking wheel stop with real through-fixing bores and yellow reflectors on both slopes. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
